* [AI4K12 Five Big Ideas in Artificial Intelligence](ai4k12-five-big-ideas-in-artificial-intelligence.md) - A framework developed by the AI for K-12 working group that organizes K–12 artificial-intelligence education around five thematic strands and four grade bands.
* [AiAWE](aiawe.md) - AiAWE is an open-source Django platform developed by John Maurice Gayed and collaborators for real-time and batch automated essay scoring, custom-rubric feedback, and formative writing support.
* [AICMFT: AI Competencies for Couple and Family Therapy](aicmft-ai-competencies-for-couple-and-family-therapy.md) - A six-domain competency framework proposed by Hertlein and colleagues for training and guiding practicing couple and family therapists in responsible AI-integrated relational practice.
* [AICO_edu (AI Competence Educators) questionnaire](aico-edu-ai-competence-educators-questionnaire.md) - AICO_edu is a teacher self-report questionnaire developed by Delcker et al.
* [AICoFe](aicofe.md) - AICoFe is a human-centered AI collaborative feedback system developed by Alvaro Becerra and colleagues that supports peer, self-, and teacher assessment through customized rubrics, multimodal performance recording, dashboards, and mediated AI-generated feedback.
* [AICoFe Visualization Module](aicofe-visualization-module.md) - AICoFe's Visualization Module is a Dash-based learning-analytics dashboard system developed by Becerra et al.
* [AIDA](aida.md) - A human-centred generative-AI digital assistant developed by the Open University to provide provenance-grounded, pedagogically configured learning support, feedback, quiz practice, and study guidance.
* [AIDE: AI-Assisted Data Extraction tool](aide-ai-assisted-data-extraction-tool.md) - A free, open-source R package and web application developed by Schroeder et al.
* [AIOS ARC prevalidated 144-item residency-training questionnaire (READS)](aios-arc-prevalidated-144-item-residency-training-questionnaire-reads.md) - A 144-item questionnaire commissioned by the Academic and Research Committee of the All India Ophthalmological Society to assess ophthalmologists' retrospective exposure to retinal diagnostic and surgical training during residency.
* [Air Reading](air-reading.md) - Air Reading is an assessment-driven virtual tutoring programme that provides frequent small-group foundational reading instruction through qualified live tutors and is operated by Air Tutors.
* [Air Tutors](air-tutors.md) - Air Tutors is a virtual high-dosage math tutoring programme run by Air Tutors that provides small-group online tutoring for upper-elementary and early-middle-school students.
* [Airway Management Outcome Score (AMOS)](airway-management-outcome-score-amos.md) - A three-point composite performance measure created by the study authors to evaluate the effectiveness and patient impact of medical students' airway-management actions in simulated difficult-airway scenarios.
* [AISSA](aissa.md) - AISSA is a web-based platform developed by Alvaro Becerra et al.
* [AITAQS four-dimensional framework of AI tutoring acceptance quality](aitaqs-four-dimensional-framework-of-ai-tutoring-acceptance-quality.md) - A learner-perceived self-report assessment framework for higher-education students that measures AI tutoring acceptance quality across feedback quality, instructional effectiveness, interaction experience, and user trust.
* [AITS: An Intelligent Tutoring System for Teaching Search Algorithms](aits-an-intelligent-tutoring-system-for-teaching-search-algorithms.md) - AITS is a web-based intelligent tutoring system developed by Grivokostopoulou et al.
* [AIvaluate](aivaluate.md) - AIvaluate is a browser-based conversational assessment agent developed by Habeeb Yusuf et al.
* [AIxSuture dataset of 314 expert-rated open suturing videos with OSATS-based three-level skill labels](aixsuture-dataset-of-314-expert-rated-open-suturing-videos-with-osats-based-three-level-sk.md) - A publicly released corpus of 314 standardized open-suturing videos from medical and dental students, annotated by independent raters using eight OSATS categories and three-level skill labels for surgical-skill assessment research.
* [ALA-Reader](ala-reader.md) - ALA-Reader is a software tool used with Pathfinder network analysis to automatically elicit and represent students’ knowledge structures from essay text.
* [ALAS dropout prevention program](alas-dropout-prevention-program.md) - ALAS is a multi-component dropout-prevention programme for middle- and high-school students that combines counselor mentoring, attendance and performance monitoring, resilience and self-control instruction, parent training, recognition activities, and community-service coordination.
* [Alder's high-touch, whole adult support approach](alders-high-touch-whole-adult-support-approach.md) - Alder's framework for proactively coordinating academic, financial, social, health, housing, and career supports for teacher-residency candidates facing barriers to completing graduate-level preparation.
* [ALEKS and ALEKS PPL behavioral trace datasets for studying AI-era learning behavior](aleks-and-aleks-ppl-behavioral-trace-datasets-for-studying-ai-era-learning-behavior.md) - Large-scale datasets made available by ALEKS containing learning interactions, placement-assessment responses, response times, and retention-item outcomes for studying mathematics learning behavior.
* [ALEKS Placement, Preparation and Learning (ALEKS PPL)](aleks-placement-preparation-and-learning-aleks-ppl.md) - ALEKS PPL is McGraw Hill's adaptive mathematics placement and preparation assessment for placing post-secondary students into appropriate college mathematics courses.
* [Alelo VCAT Virtual Cultural Awareness Trainers with multi-role Virtual Coach](alelo-vcat-virtual-cultural-awareness-trainers-with-multi-role-virtual-coach.md) - Alelo's VCAT software systems teach cultural knowledge and intercultural interaction through simulated encounters with virtual role-players supported by a fading virtual coach.
* [ALF (Augmented Lectures Feedback System)](alf-augmented-lectures-feedback-system.md) - ALF is an augmented-reality classroom feedback system developed by Zarraonandia and colleagues that displays students' reported understanding and responses to teachers wearing AR glasses.
* [Alfred Trauma Team Reception and Resuscitation Training (TTRRT) programme](alfred-trauma-team-reception-and-resuscitation-training-ttrrt-programme.md) - A standardized simulation-based trauma team training programme developed and delivered by The Alfred Hospital for multidisciplinary clinicians, combining pre-learning, lectures, skills stations, simulated scenarios, and structured debriefing.
* [Algebra Toolkit](algebra-toolkit.md) - The Algebra Toolkit is a Regional Educational Laboratory Central at Mathematica professional development programme that supports middle and high school algebra educators through facilitated PLC sessions, preparation, classroom implementation, and school-leader guidance.
* [AlgebraByExample](algebrabyexample.md) - AlgebraByExample is a freely downloadable set of algebra worked-example and problem-solving assignments co-developed by researchers, teachers, and mathematics administrators in the SERP-MSAN partnership.
* [Algebraic Achievement Test (AAT)](algebraic-achievement-test-aat.md) - A researcher-developed 50-item multiple-choice assessment for Nigerian JS2 students covering algebraic expressions, simple linear equations, and algebraic expansions.
* [Algebraic Success Test (AST)](algebraic-success-test-ast.md) - A 21-item researcher-developed algebra achievement test used to measure seventh-grade students’ understanding of algebraic expressions and operations, with reported item-analysis and KR-20 reliability evidence.
* [AlgoRAG](algorag.md) - A retrieval-augmented generation software system developed by Sushan Adhikari for providing context-grounded assistance in theoretical computer science education.
* [Alharbi et al. (2026) Scenario Rubric, Artefact Rubric, and engagement index](alharbi-et-al-2026-scenario-rubric-artefact-rubric-and-engagement-index.md) - A set of original instruments developed by Alharbi et al.
* [Alice](alice.md) - Alice is a 3D programming environment developed by Carnegie Mellon University that lets learners create animations, videos, and games by assembling code blocks and observing object behavior in a virtual world.
* [Alice in Wonderland silent-versus-oral reproduction tests](alice-in-wonderland-silent-versus-oral-reproduction-tests.md) - A reading-comprehension assessment developed by Mead that has pupils read an Alice in Wonderland passage silently and orally, then reproduces and scores the points recalled under each condition.
* [Alignment and coherence framework with six interrelated domains for system improvement](alignment-and-coherence-framework-with-six-interrelated-domains-for-system-improvement.md) - A Walrond et al.
* [ALIVE (Astronomy Learning in Immersive Virtual Environments)](alive-astronomy-learning-in-immersive-virtual-environments.md) - ALIVE is a set of interactive astronomy visualization modules developed collaboratively by the Denver Museum of Nature & Science and Metropolitan State University of Denver for delivery in planetarium domes and classrooms.
* [ALL-SAFE](all-safe.md) - ALL-SAFE is an open-source, low-bandwidth online laparoscopic-surgery training platform developed by surgeons from Africa and the United States in partnership with PAACS, combining case-based modules, expert videos, video submission and review, and a low-cost user-assembled box trainer.
* [Alliance for Resource Equity (ARE) diagnostic toolkit organized around ten dimensions of equity](alliance-for-resource-equity-are-diagnostic-toolkit-organized-around-ten-dimensions-of-equ.md) - A toolkit developed by the Education Trust and Education Resource Strategies that helps district and school leaders diagnose inequities across ten dimensions of student experience and select guidebook actions for improvement.
* [ALPHA (Athlete Learning Program about Health and Anti-Doping)](alpha-athlete-learning-program-about-health-and-anti-doping.md) - WADA's interactive e-learning anti-doping programme, translated into Chinese by CHINADA, comprising eight modules on anti-doping knowledge, ethical decision-making, doping-control procedures, and resisting pressure to dope.
* [ALS Technical Skills Self-Efficacy Perception (ALS-SEP) Form with 100-mm Visual Analog Scale](als-technical-skills-self-efficacy-perception-als-sep-form-with-100-mm-visual-analog-scale.md) - A nine-item, guideline-aligned visual-analog self-report assessment developed by Koçkaya Pınar Daylan and colleagues to measure emergency-medicine interns’ perceived self-efficacy in advanced life-support technical skills.
* [Alternative Uses Test response dataset of over 20,000 responses from more than 2,000 participants](alternative-uses-test-response-dataset-of-over-20000-responses-from-more-than-2000-partici.md) - An open dataset of more than 20,000 Alternative Uses Test responses from over 2,000 adult participants, with study materials and analysis code released through the OSF repository by Organisciak et al.
* [Alumni Survey Roadmap](alumni-survey-roadmap.md) - The authors’ nine-step framework guides organizations through co-designing, launching, interpreting, and acting on a first alumni survey.
* [Ambu Broncho Simulator](ambu-broncho-simulator.md) - A named augmented-reality AI navigation and feedback system for self-directed flexible-bronchoscopy training, developed for critical-care physicians and pulmonary bronchoscopists.
* [America's Teacher Corps (ATC)](americas-teacher-corps-atc.md) - A proposed federal programme to recognize highly effective K–12 public school teachers and provide eligible teachers, especially those in high-poverty Title I schools, with recognition, salary supplements, and a portable credential.
* [American Board for Certification of Teacher Excellence (ABCTE) alternative teacher certification](american-board-for-certification-of-teacher-excellence-abcte-alternative-teacher-certifica.md) - A teacher-certification pathway, including the Passport to Teaching credential, developed and administered by the American Board for Certification of Teacher Excellence for alternative-route teacher candidates.
* [American Industrial Arts Student Association (AIASA) student industrial arts clubs](american-industrial-arts-student-association-aiasa-student-industrial-arts-clubs.md) - A national student-club programme organized by the American Industrial Arts Association to familiarize students with industrial and technical fields through tours, club activities, and leadership conferences.
* [American Sign Language Assessment Instrument (ASLAI)](american-sign-language-assessment-instrument-aslai.md) - The ASLAI is a computerized battery of video-presented multiple-choice receptive ASL language tasks developed by the research team for assessing deaf students' ASL abilities and informing IEP planning.
* [Ames Philosophical Belief Inventory](ames-philosophical-belief-inventory.md) - A forced-choice questionnaire developed to measure education students' beliefs across five philosophical dimensions: Realism, Idealism, Pragmatism, Existentialism, and Phenomenology.
* [Amico dual-mode prototype (AmicoMio and AmicoTuo)](amico-dual-mode-prototype-amicomio-and-amicotuo.md) - A Benedetti-developed AI-mediated educational interaction device, deployable as a digital agent or social robot, that provides either procedural task guidance or reflective dialogue under age-sensitive configuration and governance constraints.
* [Amira](amira.md) - Amira Learning's Amira is an AI-powered personal reading tutor that assesses oral reading fluency, provides individualized reading practice and intervention, and reports diagnostic information to educators and families.
* [Amplify Science](amplify-science.md) - Amplify Science is a phenomena-based K–8 science curriculum developed and provided by Amplify Education, integrating hands-on investigation, literacy practices, modeling, and explanation to support three-dimensional science learning.
* [AMSTAR-2](amstar-2.md) - AMSTAR-2 is a structured critical-appraisal instrument developed by Shea and colleagues for assessing the methodological quality and overall confidence of systematic reviews of healthcare and educational evidence.
* [AMSTI](amsti.md) - The Alabama Math, Science, and Technology Initiative is a state-run programme that combines summer teacher training, school-year coaching, and rotating instructional materials kits to support hands-on, inquiry-based mathematics and science instruction.
* [An American Citizenship Course in United States History](an-american-citizenship-course-in-united-states-history.md) - A four-book United States history curriculum with an additional General Course, published for the American Citizenship League for use in American citizenship education.
* [Analyst image-detection open code, data, and stimulus release](analyst-image-detection-open-code-data-and-stimulus-release.md) - A public GitHub release by Negar Kamali and colleagues containing study code, de-identified data, and balanced real and AI-generated stimulus images for research on human detection of diffusion-model imagery.
* [Analytics Layers for Learning Design framework](analytics-layers-for-learning-design-framework.md) - A framework that organizes analytics for learning-design decision-making into learning-experience, learning-design-element, and educator-community layers, developed for use by learning-design stakeholders.
* [Anatomage Table (Medical Convertible, EDU 8.0)](anatomage-table-medical-convertible-edu-80.md) - A touchscreen virtual-dissection and medical-imaging platform made by Anatomage, Inc.
* [Anatomy Education Environment Measurement Inventory (AEEMI)](anatomy-education-environment-measurement-inventory-aeemi.md) - A 108-item validated Likert-scale inventory developed by Mohammadi Shabnam et al.
* [Anatomy Interactives](anatomy-interactives.md) - An iSpring-based web laboratory manual developed and hosted by the study institution to provide anatomy images, donor-based identification activities, quizzes, and formative feedback for health-professions students.
* [Andes2 physics tutoring system](andes2-physics-tutoring-system.md) - Andes2 is an intelligent tutoring system for supporting students solving introductory physics homework problems, including algebraic equation solving and validity checking.
* [ANECA-defined academic performance metrics framework](aneca-defined-academic-performance-metrics-framework.md) - A Spanish National Quality Evaluation and Accreditation Agency (ANECA) framework of subject-, semester-, and degree-level indicators for measuring university students’ academic progression, efficiency, success, and graduation.
* [ANet](anet.md) - ANet is a school-improvement programme run by Achievement Network that combines interim assessments, data tools, leader coaching, and peer-school networks to support data-based instruction in mathematics and English language arts.
* [ANGIO Mentor three-dimensional vascular simulator system (Simbionix)](angio-mentor-three-dimensional-vascular-simulator-system-simbionix.md) - ANGIO Mentor is a Simbionix commercial endovascular simulator that provides three-dimensional vascular scenarios, haptic catheter and wire interaction, simulated fluoroscopy, and procedure scoring for clinical skills training.
* [Annotated oral English corpus of 4,374 recordings from 486 Chinese university students across five diagnostic dimensions](annotated-oral-english-corpus-of-4374-recordings-from-486-chinese-university-students-acro.md) - A corpus created by Chai Rui containing 4,374 recorded oral-English performances from 486 Chinese university students, scored by trained evaluators across five diagnostic dimensions for model training and evaluation.
* [Annotated R syntax and OSF repository for replicating MAIHDA analyses](annotated-r-syntax-and-osf-repository-for-replicating-maihda-analyses.md) - An OSF-hosted set of annotated R scripts and step-by-step analytical code for conducting and reproducing intersectional MAIHDA analyses, created by Keller et al.
* [Annotated reflective-writing sentence dataset of 5080 sentences from 76 student essays](annotated-reflective-writing-sentence-dataset-of-5080-sentences-from-76-student-essays.md) - A corpus of 5,080 sentence-level annotations from higher-education reflective writings, created by Thomas Daniel Ullmann to support automated assessment of reflective writing.
* [Annotated student-utterance emotion dataset (224 turns) for text-based emotion recognition in math tutoring](annotated-student-utterance-emotion-dataset-224-turns-for-text-based-emotion-recognition-i.md) - Debanjana Kar et al.'s dataset contains 224 manually annotated MathDial-Bridge student turns with boredom, engagement, or neutral labels and polarity scores for developing emotion-recognition models in math tutoring dialogues.
* [Anonymised raw patient dataset supplement for the experienced vs. inexperienced surgeon PPV comparison](anonymised-raw-patient-dataset-supplement-for-the-experienced-vs-inexperienced-surgeon-ppv.md) - An anonymised patient-level dataset containing demographic characteristics, surgery details, outcomes, and complications for analysing experienced versus inexperienced surgeon effects on vitreoretinal surgery outcomes, released by Pencak Martin et al.
* [Anonymized Dutch student-monitoring test-score dataset covering 15% of primary schools, 2017 to 2020](anonymized-dutch-student-monitoring-test-score-dataset-covering-15-of-primary-schools-2017.md) - A confidential, anonymized dataset assembled by Engzell et al.
* [Anonymous online medical English course evaluation questionnaire](anonymous-online-medical-english-course-evaluation-questionnaire.md) - A 14-item anonymous five-point Likert questionnaire developed by Lin Qiang et al.
* [ANSYS Workbench](ansys-workbench.md) - ANSYS Workbench is an engineering simulation platform made by Ansys, Inc., used to build and analyze finite-element models for applications such as heat transfer.
* [Anti-RAMSing toolkit: annotated R scripts and worked example dataset on OSF](anti-ramsing-toolkit-annotated-r-scripts-and-worked-example-dataset-on-osf.md) - A publicly available toolkit by Bicakci et al.
* [AntiSkillBench](antiskillbench.md) - AntiSkillBench is a benchmark dataset and evaluation suite created by Yongli Xiang et al.
* [ANTS behavioural marker system](ants-behavioural-marker-system.md) - A behavioural marker assessment system developed by the University of Aberdeen for training and evaluating anaesthetists' non-technical skills through four categories, 15 elements, and calibrated observer ratings.
* [ANTT wound-dressing observational metric](antt-wound-dressing-observational-metric.md) - A three-phase, 31-step observational assessment instrument developed by Hegarty and colleagues for scoring nurses’ and trainee healthcare professionals’ aseptic non-touch wound-dressing performance and errors in simulated or clinical practice.
* [ANVIL](anvil.md) - ANVIL is an open-source generative software pipeline developed by Noviello et al.
* [ANZCA nine-point entrustment scale](anzca-nine-point-entrustment-scale.md) - A nine-point workplace-based assessment scale developed and used by ANZCA to rate the level of supervision required by anaesthesia trainees, with parallel supervisor and trainee descriptors.
* [API Can Code](api-can-code.md) - API Can Code is an interest-driven high-school data-science curriculum developed by Rotem Israel-Fishelson and collaborators that uses public APIs, EduBlocks, and CODAP for authentic data exploration and communication.
* [APLUS (Artificial Peer Learning Using SimStudent)](aplus-artificial-peer-learning-using-simstudent.md) - APLUS is an online learning-by-teaching environment developed by its researchers in which students tutor the SimStudent virtual agent to solve algebraic equations through guided problem solving.
* [Applications of Derivative Test (ADT)](applications-of-derivative-test-adt.md) - A researcher-developed calculus assessment by Mehmet Fatih Ocal comprising six open-ended questions that measure undergraduate students' conceptual and procedural knowledge of derivative applications.
* [Apprentice Learner Architecture](apprentice-learner-architecture.md) - A domain-general architecture and authoring framework by MacLellan and Koedinger for creating teachable-agent tutors with learner models that can be trained across diverse instructional domains.
* [Approaches to Teaching Inventory-Revised (ATI-R)](approaches-to-teaching-inventory-revised-ati-r.md) - A course-specific 22-item self-report inventory developed by Trigwell and Prosser for measuring academics' teacher/content-focused and student/learning-focused approaches to teaching.
* [APTA (Adaptive Peer Tutoring Assistant)](apta-adaptive-peer-tutoring-assistant.md) - A software environment developed by Walker et al.
* [Aptitude Test for School Beginners](aptitude-test-for-school-beginners.md) - A standardized, culture-free school-readiness assessment developed by South Africa's Human Sciences Research Council, comprising subtests of perception, spatial ability, reasoning, numerical ability, gestalt, coordination, memory, and verbal expression.
* [AR Magic Mirror system](ar-magic-mirror-system.md) - A screen-based augmented-reality anatomy learning system developed at the Technical University of Munich that superimposes radiological images and 3D anatomical models on a tracked learner's body.
* [Arabic curriculum-based measurement toolkit: LNF, LSF, PSF, and WRF assessments with three alternate forms each](arabic-curriculum-based-measurement-toolkit-lnf-lsf-psf-and-wrf-assessments-with-three-alt.md) - A researcher-developed Arabic curriculum-based measurement toolkit for assessing letter naming, letter sounds, phoneme segmentation, and word-reading fluency in Saudi kindergarten and grade 1 students.
* [Arabic Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI) and Arabic IPAQ Short Form](arabic-pittsburgh-sleep-quality-index-psqi-and-arabic-ipaq-short-form.md) - Validated Modern Standard Arabic self-report instruments used to assess university students’ sleep quality and physical activity, respectively.
* [Arabic versions of the PE-ARCS and PE-MS questionnaires](arabic-versions-of-the-pe-arcs-and-pe-ms-questionnaires.md) - A bilingual-translated and Saudi-context-adapted questionnaire battery measuring autonomy, competence, relatedness, and motivational regulation among students learning physical education online.
* [Arabic-language PE-SPQ, PE-Grit and A-USEI instrument battery](arabic-language-pe-spq-pe-grit-and-a-usei-instrument-battery.md) - An Arabic-language battery of validated self-report scales developed for measuring study processes, grit, and academic engagement among university physical-education and sport students.
* [ARC Core](arc-core.md) - ARC Core is a K–12 English and Spanish literacy curriculum developed by American Reading Company that organizes extensive reading, writing, research, and analysis into knowledge-building units integrating literacy with science, social studies, and literature.
* [ARCC model (Advancing Research and Clinical Practice through Close Collaboration)](arcc-model-advancing-research-and-clinical-practice-through-close-collaboration.md) - A healthcare evidence-based-practice implementation framework that uses organizational readiness, trained mentors, and supportive strategies to build clinicians’ EBP competence and sustain practice change.
* [ARDESOS-DIAPROVE program](ardesos-diaprove-program.md) - A 16-week classroom programme developed by the ARDESOS-DIAPROVE team that teaches critical thinking through problem-based and cooperative learning activities, contextualized problems, rubrics, and feedback.
* [Argument-Driven Inquiry (ADI) laboratory instruction model](argument-driven-inquiry-adi-laboratory-instruction-model.md) - A structured science-laboratory instructional framework that organizes group inquiry, argument construction, interactive argumentation, individual scientific writing, and peer review.
* [Argus](argus.md) - Argus is a static-analysis triage tool developed by David Racovan et al.
* [ARIN-561](arin-561.md) - ARIN-561 is an educational game developed by Leitner et al.
* [Arizona linked education–child welfare student database](arizona-linked-educationchild-welfare-student-database.md) - A study-created database linking longitudinal K–12 education records from the Arizona Department of Education with child records from the Arizona Department of Child Safety to identify and describe students in foster care.
* [Arloon's The Human Body Anatomy](arloons-the-human-body-anatomy.md) - Arloon's augmented-reality anatomy application uses interactive 3D models and self-evaluation activities to teach human body systems, developed by Arloon.
* [Around the Corner (ATC)](around-the-corner-atc.md) - A Success for All Foundation preschool and kindergarten curriculum programme that combines language and early-reading lessons with child-facing computer activities, videos, Home Links, and video-based teacher professional development.
* [ARPG+ dual-process real-time coaching system](arpg-dual-process-real-time-coaching-system.md) - ARPG+ is a real-time AI coaching system developed by Ye et al.
* [Artemisa](artemisa.md) - Artemisa is a chatbot developed through the ACACIA project to provide anonymous, accessible support for university students experiencing sexual harassment and to recruit volunteers promoting diversity and tolerance.
* [ArthroSim](arthrosim.md) - ArthroSim is a high-fidelity virtual-reality knee arthroscopy simulator with finite-element anatomical modeling and dual-device haptic feedback, made by TolTech Touch of Life Technologies.
* [Arthur book-based educational television program](arthur-book-based-educational-television-program.md) - Arthur is a PBS Kids educational television programme based on Marc Brown’s storybooks, produced and distributed for young children through PBS stations and online materials.
* [Arts for Learning (A4L) Lessons Project](arts-for-learning-a4l-lessons-project.md) - A Young Audiences, Inc.
* [ARTS: Adaptive Response Time Based Sequencing](arts-adaptive-response-time-based-sequencing.md) - ARTS is an adaptive learning system developed by Everett Mettler and colleagues that sequences practice items using learner accuracy and response time to regulate spacing, priority, interleaving, and retirement.
* [AS-NTS behavioural marker system](as-nts-behavioural-marker-system.md) - A validated German behavioural-marker rating system used by instructors to assess anaesthesiology students’ planning and problem-solving, teamwork and leadership, and team-orientation skills during simulation training.
* [ASAP 2.0 dataset](asap-20-dataset.md) - The ASAP 2.0 dataset is a public benchmark of approximately 24,000 student argumentative essays with human-assigned scores from 1 to 6, developed for automated essay-scoring research.
* [ASAP-SAS corpus of short-answer scoring prompts and rubrics](asap-sas-corpus-of-short-answer-scoring-prompts-and-rubrics.md) - The ASAP-SAS corpus is a publicly available Kaggle dataset of rubric-scored short-answer responses, prompts, rubrics, and human-rater agreement benchmarks used to evaluate automated scoring systems.
* [ASCLIRE computer-based test of clinical reasoning for acute dyspnoea](asclire-computer-based-test-of-clinical-reasoning-for-acute-dyspnoea.md) - ASCLIRE is a computer-based clinical-reasoning assessment developed by Czeskleba and colleagues that uses video cases and diagnostic-test selection tasks to measure information selection, decision time, and diagnostic accuracy in acute dyspnoea.
* [ASE-26](ase-26.md) - ASE-26 is Mikael Gorsky's twenty-one-module undergraduate curriculum for teaching agentic software engineering to engineering students with foundational computer science and software-engineering knowledge.
* [ASEAN subregional EE curriculum prototypes for primary and secondary schools and pre-/in-service teacher training](asean-subregional-ee-curriculum-prototypes-for-primary-and-secondary-schools-and-pre-in-se.md) - A set of adaptable environmental-education curriculum prototypes for primary and secondary schools and teacher education, developed by UNESCO-UNEP's International Environmental Education Programme with Malaysia's Curriculum Development Centre and the University of the Philippines' ISMED.
* [Asegúrate program](asegurate-program.md) - Asegúrate is a teacher-implemented secondary-school intervention developed by Del Rey and colleagues to reduce cyber-aggression, bullying, sexting, and abusive Internet and social-network use.
* [ASGE major/minor skill framework](asge-majorminor-skill-framework.md) - A framework developed by the American Society for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy for classifying endoscopic procedures by training complexity and specifying competence and supervision requirements for major skills.
* [Ask Me Anything (AMA)](ask-me-anything-ama.md) - A Python and ChatGPT API chatbot developed by Saniya Vahedian Movahed et al.
* [Ask-Elle](ask-elle.md) - Ask-Elle is a web-based intelligent tutoring system developed for teaching first-year computer science students Haskell through strategy-based model tracing, property-based testing, and automated hints.
* [ASPIRE](aspire.md) - ASPIRE is an authoring system and deployment environment developed for creating constraint-based intelligent tutors with domain models, student modelling, adaptive feedback, and problem selection.
* [Aspiring to Educate](aspiring-to-educate.md) - A Pennsylvania state-supported programme that creates multiple pathways into teaching through preparation partnerships and financial supports for high school students, adults, paraprofessionals, and college students.
* [ASRA-ESRA UGRA competency framework](asra-esra-ugra-competency-framework.md) - A regional anesthesia competency framework developed by the ASRA-ESRA joint committee, defining six UGRA training domains and milestone-based assessment expectations for anesthesiology residents and fellows.
* [ASReview](asreview.md) - ASReview is an open-source machine-learning platform developed for efficient abstract screening in systematic reviews by iteratively prioritizing records for reviewer classification.
* [Assessing Competency in Evidence-Based Medicine (ACE) tool](assessing-competency-in-evidence-based-medicine-ace-tool.md) - A clinical-scenario-based assessment developed by Ilic et al.
* [Assessmake21](assessmake21.md) - Assessmake21 is a web-based digital self-assessment tool developed by Ourania Miliou and colleagues to help K–12 learners identify, reflect on, and document 21st-century skills during makerspace activities.

* [EMMeT-OWL](emmet-owl.md) - EMMeT-OWL is an OWL-encoded clinical knowledge base translated from Elsevier's Merged Medical Taxonomy and used by EMCQG to generate medical assessment questions.
* [EmoFindAR](emofindar.md) - EmoFindAR is a Unity-based markerless multiplayer mobile augmented-reality game developed by López-Faican et al.
* [Emotion Socialization Observation Scale (ESOS)](emotion-socialization-observation-scale-esos.md) - A structured classroom-observation assessment developed by Veraksa and colleagues to rate kindergarten teachers' reactions to children's emotions, modeling of emotional expressiveness, and teaching about emotions.
* [Emotion-reporting grid for university students based on daily experienced emotions](emotion-reporting-grid-for-university-students-based-on-daily-experienced-emotions.md) - A study-developed grid by Elise Lavoué et al.
* [Emotiv EPOC headset Affectiv Suite](emotiv-epoc-headset-affectiv-suite.md) - Emotiv's wireless EEG headset and Affectiv Suite software measure affective states such as engagement, excitement, frustration, and meditation during activities.
* [Empathy and Clarity Rating Scale (ECRS)](empathy-and-clarity-rating-scale-ecrs.md) - A seven-item behaviorally anchored rating scale developed by Terregino and colleagues for assessing empathy and clarity in medical students’ communication with patients.
* [Employment e-Training Platform](employment-e-training-platform.md) - An online vocational e-training platform proposed and maintained by Taiwan's Council of Labor Affairs, providing subject units with practice, tests, information resources, and feedback for workplace-oriented learning.
* [ENACT-E](enact-e.md) - ENACT-E is a 21-item observational rating scale adapted for assessing the competence of community-based rehabilitation and primary care lay health workers delivering psychosocial interventions in Ethiopia.
* [ENDO-AID OIP-1](endo-aid-oip-1.md) - ENDO-AID OIP-1 is Olympus's machine-learning computer-aided detection module that alerts endoscopists to suspicious colorectal lesions during live endoscopy.
* [Endo.Adm](endoadm.md) - Endo.Adm is a Python-based deep-learning quality-control and audit-and-feedback system developed by Yao Liwen et al.
* [Endodontic Complexity Assessment Tool (E-CAT)](endodontic-complexity-assessment-tool-e-cat.md) - A digital clinical assessment tool developed for objectively classifying the difficulty of non-surgical endodontic cases using patient- and tooth-specific factors.
* [Endonix plug-and-play virtual endoscopy simulator with 3D-printed handle](endonix-plug-and-play-virtual-endoscopy-simulator-with-3d-printed-handle.md) - A plug-and-play virtual endoscopy training simulator made by Endonix/Olympus that combines computer software modules with a 3D-printed endoscope handle for novice scope-control and navigation practice.
* [ENDOSCOPE FOR ENT V3.03 VR endoscopy training platform](endoscope-for-ent-v303-vr-endoscopy-training-platform.md) - A mixed-reality otorhinolaryngology endoscopy training platform developed by Zhang Yunyun et al.'s research group for resident practice, simulation-based performance assessment, and instructor guidance.
* [EndoSuture Trainer Box Simulator (ESTBS)](endosuture-trainer-box-simulator-estbs.md) - A physical laparoscopic skills-training simulator developed for medical students, surgical residents, and surgeons to practise endosuturing and related psychomotor skills under simulated conditions.
* [EndoTrainer](endotrainer.md) - EndoTrainer is SurgiTrainer's hybrid physical-virtual endoscopic training platform, combining anatomical modules, real surgical tools, sensor-based measurement, automatic performance evaluation, personalized curricula, and augmented-reality feedback.
* [Energizers](energizers.md) - Energizers is a classroom-based physical-activity programme developed for elementary students and implemented during the school day to increase activity and support on-task behaviour.
* [Energy Skate Park: Basics (ESPB)](energy-skate-park-basics-espb.md) - A PhET Interactive Simulations physics simulation that lets learners explore conservation of energy and energy relationships by manipulating a skater, track, mass, and friction.
* [ENGAGE](engage.md) - ENGAGE is a Unity-based game learning environment that teaches computational thinking to middle school students through an immersive underwater storyworld, visual programming tasks, and progressive challenge levels.
* [Engagement Classroom Model (ECM)](engagement-classroom-model-ecm.md) - A classroom implementation framework described by McWilliam et al.
* [Engagement with School and Learning survey](engagement-with-school-and-learning-survey.md) - An online pupil self-report survey developed by Victoria Menzies and colleagues to measure secondary pupils' engagement with school and learning across identity, motivation, ability beliefs, participation, and work-completion behaviour.
* [English Listening Lesson Library Online (ELLLO)](english-listening-lesson-library-online-elllo.md) - ELLLO is an online English-listening courseware and lesson library run by ELLLO.org, offering ESL learners audio lessons from varied speakers and countries with vocabulary, comprehension, and cloze exercises.
* [Enhanced Core Reading Instruction](enhanced-core-reading-instruction.md) - Enhanced Core Reading Instruction is a structured literacy intervention programme with professional development materials for teachers, interventionists, and literacy leaders.
* [Enhanced Milieu Teaching (EMT)](enhanced-milieu-teaching-emt.md) - Enhanced Milieu Teaching is a semistructured, naturalistic, play-based language intervention implemented by trained teachers, parents, or clinicians to develop functional language skills in young children with language delays.
* [Enhanced Proactive Reading](enhanced-proactive-reading.md) - A 120-lesson small-group early literacy, language arts, and English language development curriculum for first-grade English language learners experiencing reading difficulties, developed for delivery in daily sessions by teachers.
* [Enhancing the Skills of Early Childhood Trainers training pack](enhancing-the-skills-of-early-childhood-trainers-training-pack.md) - A Bernard van Leer Foundation training-pack curriculum, co-published with UNESCO, that combines early childhood development theory with experiential participatory methods for trainer-of-trainers courses or self-learning.
* [Entonasyon Değerlendirme Formu](entonasyon-degerlendirme-formu.md) - A 44-item, seven-point intonation-assessment form developed by Yakup Aksoy that converts cent-level deviations in violin students’ target notes into categorical accuracy scores.
* [Entrepreneurial Attitude Orientation (EAO) scale adapted from Robinson et al. (1991)](entrepreneurial-attitude-orientation-eao-scale-adapted-from-robinson-et-al-1991.md) - An adapted 21-item Likert self-report assessment used by Charity et al.
* [Envi-Geo Info System (EGIS) package](envi-geo-info-system-egis-package.md) - A C# computer-mediated instructional package developed by Adeleke to integrate GIS-based environmental-education concepts into junior-secondary social studies teaching.
* [Environmental awareness knowledge test developed for the study](environmental-awareness-knowledge-test-developed-for-the-study.md) - A 50-item multiple-choice achievement test developed by Gökhan Baş to measure Turkish seventh graders' environmental-awareness knowledge aligned with the elementary science and technology curriculum.
* [Environmental Education Efficacy Belief Instrument (EEEBI)](environmental-education-efficacy-belief-instrument-eeebi.md) - Developed by Sia (1992), the EEEBI is a 23-item Likert-type assessment of preservice teachers’ personal environmental-education teaching efficacy and outcome expectancy beliefs.
* [Environmental Information Achievement Test (EAT)](environmental-information-achievement-test-eat.md) - A validated achievement test developed for Adeleke's study to assess junior secondary pupils' knowledge and retention of environmental-education concepts.
* [EOS Opportunity Chart](eos-opportunity-chart.md) - A data-reporting tool developed by Equal Opportunity Schools that helps schools and districts compare disaggregated advanced-course seats, enrollments, and success with their student demographics.
* [EOS Student Insight Card](eos-student-insight-card.md) - Equal Opportunity Schools' assessment tool compiles students' interests, aspirations, motivation, and trusted-staff recommendations to inform access to advanced coursework.
* [eoSim augmented reality laparoscopic simulator](eosim-augmented-reality-laparoscopic-simulator.md) - eoSim is a commercial mobile augmented-reality laparoscopic simulator made by EoSurgical Ltd.
* [ePA Coach](epa-coach.md) - ePA Coach is a web-based microlearning platform developed by Perotti et al.
* [EPA framework for teaching and assessing ward round practice](epa-framework-for-teaching-and-assessing-ward-round-practice.md) - A clinical-education framework that links ward-round tasks to required competencies and entrustment decisions for medical students and doctors, proposed by Vietz et al.
* [EPA-based consultation-request assessment instrument set (EPA document, Resident Supervisor Instrument, Intern Self-Reflection Instrument)](epa-based-consultation-request-assessment-instrument-set-epa-document-resident-supervisor.md) - A clinical-education assessment set developed by Kang et al.
* [EPIC Charter School Consortium school-and-teacher-effectiveness measurement system](epic-charter-school-consortium-school-and-teacher-effectiveness-measurement-system.md) - A Mathematica Policy Research measurement system used by the EPIC charter school consortium to identify effective schools and teachers across its member charter schools.
* [EpiduroSIM](epidurosim.md) - EpiduroSIM is a Unity-based virtual epiduroscopy simulator developed by Lee Jong Joo et al.
* [EPIGAME (The Fuzzy Chronicles)](epigame-the-fuzzy-chronicles.md) - A digital puzzle game developed by Martinez-Garza et al.
* [EPIQ-AI Readiness Framework](epiq-ai-readiness-framework.md) - A framework developed by Sangwa et al.
* [Epistemic violence-freedom scale](epistemic-violence-freedom-scale.md) - A 29-item Likert-scale instrument developed by Kartal et al.
* [Epistemological Belief Scale (EBS) developed for the study](epistemological-belief-scale-ebs-developed-for-the-study.md) - A 29-item Likert-type scale developed by Kızkapan et al.
* [Epistemological Beliefs Assessment for Physical Sciences (EBAPS)](epistemological-beliefs-assessment-for-physical-sciences-ebaps.md) - EBAPS is a 30-item assessment instrument developed to measure physical-science students' epistemological beliefs across five non-orthogonal dimensions using prescribed weighted axis scores.
* [ePOCT+](epoct.md) - ePOCT+ is a tablet-based, digital IMCI-informed clinical decision-support algorithm developed and implemented by the DYNAMIC project to guide outpatient pediatric assessment, diagnosis, testing, and management.
* [ePSRL Management System](epsrl-management-system.md) - A purpose-built electronic personalised self-regulated learning management system developed by Khiat and colleagues to support learners' planning, monitoring, appraisal, reflection, and learning analytics throughout the learning process.
* [Equatio and Mathspace](equatio-and-mathspace.md) - Equatio is Texthelp's digital mathematics equation editor and accessibility tool, while Mathspace is a digital workspace for working with equations, shapes, and freehand drawings; teachers and students use them in mathematics instruction.
* [EQUIP (Electronic Quality of Inquiry Protocol)](equip-electronic-quality-of-inquiry-protocol.md) - A classroom observation protocol developed by Marshall and colleagues that rates inquiry-based instruction across instruction, assessment, discourse, and curriculum on a four-level scale.
* [Equitized Syllabus](equitized-syllabus.md) - The Equitized Syllabus is a shared syllabus template developed and standardized by BMCC for adoption across course sections and partner colleges.
* [Equity, Agency and Transparency (EAT) framework](equity-agency-and-transparency-eat-framework.md) - A research-informed framework developed by Rutherford et al.
* [Equity-5C (E-5C) model for computing education](equity-5c-e-5c-model-for-computing-education.md) - A computing-equity planning framework developed by Li et al.
* [Equity-centered, vendor-accountable edtech evaluation system model](equity-centered-vendor-accountable-edtech-evaluation-system-model.md) - A proposed community-college edtech evaluation and procurement framework from Van Nostrand et al.
* [Equity-Explicit Establish-Maintain-Restore (E-EMR)](equity-explicit-establish-maintain-restore-e-emr.md) - Duong et al.'s E-EMR is a professional-development framework that guides teachers through Establish, Maintain, and Restore relationship practices while embedding equity levers to support racially minoritized students.
* [ER-VIPE (Emergency Room-Virtual Interprofessional Education)](er-vipe-emergency-room-virtual-interprofessional-education.md) - ER-VIPE is a 3D virtual interprofessional emergency-room simulation platform developed for healthcare education and used by medical, nursing, pharmacy, radiological technology, and medical technology learners.
* [ERWC](erwc.md) - The Expository Reading and Writing Course is a curriculum and associated teacher professional-learning and coaching programme developed and implemented to support secondary students' expository reading and writing.
* [ERWC 3.0 curriculum](erwc-30-curriculum.md) - A California State University-developed college-preparatory English language arts curriculum comprising 67 selectable modules for grade 11–12 courses, with integrated reading, writing, discussion, English Language Development, and Universal Design for Learning features.
* [EscapED model](escaped-model.md) - A six-component framework proposed by Clarke et al.
* [ESCO (European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations) framework](esco-european-skills-competences-qualifications-and-occupations-framework.md) - A multilingual European classification framework maintained by the European Centre for the Development of Vocational Training (Cedefop) for mapping skills, competences, qualifications, and occupations across education and employment contexts.
* [ESNPNSD](esnpnsd.md) - ESNPNSD is a web-based educational electronic system developed by Abedi Ali et al.
* [ESNPNSD system](esnpnsd-system.md) - A nursing education support system that integrates patient-care documentation, experience sharing, and curated educational resources for clinical-internship learning.
* [ESO Certificates of Competence and Advanced Studies Program (CCASP)](eso-certificates-of-competence-and-advanced-studies-program-ccasp.md) - A part-time blended postgraduate oncology education and certification programme run by the European School of Oncology in collaboration with the Universities of Ulm and Zurich, combining seminars, e-learning modules, module tests, and a final certification examination.
* [ESPE e-Learning website](espe-e-learning-website.md) - A free, globally accessible ESPE–ISPAD e-learning platform run and maintained by the ESPE–ISPAD e-learning committee, providing pediatric endocrinology and diabetes chapters, clinical cases, multilingual resource-limited-setting courses, and accredited CME modules.
* [ESR eGUIDE](esr-eguide.md) - ESR eGUIDE is an online evidence-based imaging-appropriateness and clinical decision-support learning platform developed and operated by the European Society of Radiology.
* [Essential 0-5 Survey](essential-0-5-survey.md) - The Essential 0-5 Survey, created in partnership with Start Early, gathers teacher and parent perceptions to assess six organizational conditions in early-childhood education programs and provide leaders with actionable data.
* [Essentials for Community School Transformation Framework](essentials-for-community-school-transformation-framework.md) - A Community Schools Forward framework that extends the traditional four community-school pillars with belonging, safety, and care, and rigorous community-connected classroom instruction to guide whole-child school transformation.
* [Essentials in Minimally Invasive Gynecology (EMIG)](essentials-in-minimally-invasive-gynecology-emig.md) - AAGL's EMIG is a gynecologic minimally invasive skills-training package combining a cognitive question database, online didactic materials, and laparoscopic and hysteroscopic psychomotor simulation exercises.
* [Estonian reflective-writing AI-feedback corpus of 2988 homework triplets from 283 students](estonian-reflective-writing-ai-feedback-corpus-of-2988-homework-triplets-from-283-students.md) - A restricted corpus created by Andres Karjus et al.
* [ESTS/EACTS Delphi consensus framework for robotic thoracic training](estseacts-delphi-consensus-framework-for-robotic-thoracic-training.md) - A European Society of Thoracic Surgeons and European Association of Cardiothoracic Surgery framework specifying simulation, supervised console practice, and proctored assessment for robotic thoracic surgery training.
* [eSylvan](esylvan.md) - eSylvan was Sylvan Learning Centers' early Internet-based tutoring environment for delivering its reading, writing, and mathematics curriculum through teacher-led online sessions.
* [Ethical AI and Workforce Readiness (EAWR) micro-credential framework](ethical-ai-and-workforce-readiness-eawr-micro-credential-framework.md) - A proposed micro-credential framework by İsmail Şan et al.
* [Ethics Quarter (EQ)](ethics-quarter-eq.md) - A six-week, 12-quarter e-learning ethics intervention developed at the University of Turku for nurse managers, covering ethics knowledge, ethical influence, ethics research, and ethical problem solving.
* [Ethics Training Agents](ethics-training-agents.md) - A web-based multi-human, multi-agent LLM discussion system developed by Seo et al.
* [ETS and NTC comprehensive teacher induction programs](ets-and-ntc-comprehensive-teacher-induction-programs.md) - Comprehensive teacher-induction programmes developed by the Educational Testing Service and the New Teacher Center that provide beginning teachers with trained mentors, orientation, professional development, observation, and formative feedback.
* [European Commission's Digital Competence Framework (DigComp)](european-commissions-digital-competence-framework-digcomp.md) - A European Commission framework that defines digital competence through five competence areas and progressive proficiency levels for citizens and educational assessment.
* [European Geriatric Medicine Specialty Exam (EGeMSE)](european-geriatric-medicine-specialty-exam-egemse.md) - The EGeMSE is a UEMS-GMS examination developed with the British Geriatrics Society and the UK Royal Colleges to assess theoretical geriatric-medicine knowledge in doctors in training and qualified specialists.
* [European Training Requirements (ETR) framework](european-training-requirements-etr-framework.md) - A UEMS-developed framework defining adaptable minimum competency and training standards for postgraduate medical specialist education in Europe.
* [EurOP²E — the European Open Platform for Prescribing Education](europ2e-the-european-open-platform-for-prescribing-education.md) - An open educational platform established by the European Association of Clinical Pharmacology and Therapeutics (EACPT) to facilitate international collaboration and sharing of online prescribing-education resources.
* [Evaluating the Relationships Between Poverty and School Performance interactive data visualization gallery](evaluating-the-relationships-between-poverty-and-school-performance-interactive-data-visua.md) - An interactive data-visualization gallery released and operated by NWEA Research to let users explore relationships between school poverty, achievement, and growth in the report's sample.
* [Evaluation scale of gerontological nursing competence for higher vocational nursing students (35 items, four dimensions)](evaluation-scale-of-gerontological-nursing-competence-for-higher-vocational-nursing-studen.md) - A 35-item five-point Likert self-assessment developed by the research team to measure higher vocational nursing students’ gerontological nursing competence across practice, professional development, communication and cooperation, and legal-ethical quality.
* [EVER](ever.md) - An open-ended, formative template proposed by Natalia Kucirkova and colleagues for evaluating and strengthening evidence about educational technology, intended to complement internal research and national standards.
* [Every Circuit](every-circuit.md) - Every Circuit is a web-based and mobile interactive circuit simulator developed by MuseMaze that lets learners construct circuits and observe electrical quantities and behavior.
* [Every Learner Everywhere Lighthouse Institution Program and Technical Assistance Model](every-learner-everywhere-lighthouse-institution-program-and-technical-assistance-model.md) - A Gates Foundation-funded Every Learner Everywhere initiative in which a network of organizations helps participating colleges implement adaptive courseware in gateway courses through technical assistance, communities of practice, subgrants, and research support.
* [EveryDay Intervention](everyday-intervention.md) - A school- and district-partnered attendance intervention that analyzes attendance data and mails personalized absence reports to parents or guardians of students at risk of chronic absenteeism.
* [Everyday Mathematics®](everyday-mathematics.md) - Everyday Mathematics® is a comprehensive pre-K–6 mathematics curriculum developed by the University of Chicago School Mathematics Project, combining teacher guides, student materials, manipulatives, games, technology, and repeated exposure to mathematical content.
* [Evidence for the Frontline (E4F) online evidence brokerage service](evidence-for-the-frontline-e4f-online-evidence-brokerage-service.md) - A bespoke web-based service developed by Sandringham School, the Institute for Effective Education at the University of York, and the Coalition for Evidence Based Education that brokers teachers' and school leaders' questions to relevant research evidence and academics.
* [Evidence to Insights (e2i) Coach](evidence-to-insights-e2i-coach.md) - A free online platform offered by the Regional Educational Laboratory Mid-Atlantic that helps schools and teachers use their own data to identify effective remote-learning strategies and refine practice.
* [Evidence-based internet research tool (EBR tool)](evidence-based-internet-research-tool-ebr-tool.md) - A web-based tool developed to teach undergraduate students across disciplines how to formulate evidence-based questions, search for information, and critically appraise online sources.
* [Ewha TBL end-of-session feedback questionnaire](ewha-tbl-end-of-session-feedback-questionnaire.md) - A four-point end-of-session questionnaire developed by the Ewha Womans University College of Medicine TBL Board to gather medical students’ perceptions of TBL session management, participation, and satisfaction.
* [Ex-Lap App](ex-lap-app.md) - The Ex-Lap App is a smartphone-based learning and management application developed with BoYi Times Medical Technology for the STALS laparoscopic training course.
* [Executive Functioning Scale (EFS), Arabic-adapted parent-report instrument](executive-functioning-scale-efs-arabic-adapted-parent-report-instrument.md) - A 52-item, 5-point Likert parent-report assessment adapted into Arabic to measure cool and hot executive-function domains in children aged 7–9.
* [Expanded RIKEN SAS dataset with 10,000 new annotations](expanded-riken-sas-dataset-with-10000-new-annotations.md) - A publicly available dataset from Funayama et al.
* [Expeditionary Learning](expeditionary-learning.md) - A whole-school educational model developed and supported by EL Education that organizes schools around experiential, project-based learning and related schoolwide practices.
* [Experience Corps](experience-corps.md) - Experience Corps is a community-based programme that places adults aged 55 and older in elementary schools to tutor and mentor at-risk students, assist teachers, and lead enrichment activities.
* [Experiment Design Tool (EDT)](experiment-design-tool-edt.md) - A software scaffold integrated into an online inquiry-learning environment that guides learners through designing, conducting, and analyzing virtual experiments; developed by Siswa van Riesen et al.
* [Expert-annotated clinical consultation corpus of 207 sessions and 4,815 messages with four annotation dimensions](expert-annotated-clinical-consultation-corpus-of-207-sessions-and-4815-messages-with-four.md) - Yang et al.'s dataset contains 207 medical-student clinical history-taking sessions and 4,815 human–AI dialogue turns annotated by clinical experts for message fidelity, dialogue intent, scaffolding need, and OSCE performance.
* [Expert-annotated Hungarian reflective essay dataset](expert-annotated-hungarian-reflective-essay-dataset.md) - A corpus of approximately 1,954 Hungarian reflective essays from Early Childhood Education students, expert-annotated on a four-level reflection scale by Zsolt Csibi and colleagues.
* [Expert-panel-scored MRI empathic communication scenario tool with nine scaffolded steps and 1–3 response scoring](expert-panel-scored-mri-empathic-communication-scenario-tool-with-nine-scaffolded-steps-an.md) - A study-developed scenario-based assessment and training instrument for trainee radiographers and medical-imaging practitioners to select empathic responses when explaining MRI procedures to anxious patients.
* [Expert-vetted assessment suite of GUI-oriented vibe-coding tasks with scoring criteria](expert-vetted-assessment-suite-of-gui-oriented-vibe-coding-tasks-with-scoring-criteria.md) - An expert-designed assessment suite of natural-language GUI-oriented vibe-coding tasks with predefined scoring criteria and rubrics, developed by the article's international subject-matter-expert panel for tertiary students.
* [Expository Reading and Writing Course (ERWC)](expository-reading-and-writing-course-erwc.md) - The Expository Reading and Writing Course is a college-preparatory English language arts curriculum developed by the California State University system for secondary students, with modules that integrate rhetorical reading, writing, revision, and language study.
* [Extended 36-trial Red-Blue Test](extended-36-trial-red-blue-test.md) - A computer-based Stroop/Day-Night-adapted assessment for early primary school children that measures inhibitory control through 36 rule-reversal color-naming trials scored by accuracy.
* [Extended Aggression Replacement Training (ART) programme](extended-aggression-replacement-training-art-programme.md) - A manualized group intervention for children and adolescents with behavioural problems that combines social-skills training, anger-control training, and moral-reasoning or character-education training, delivered by trained ART facilitators.
* [Extended labelled dataset of 345 OER sentences with ethnic-bias annotations from 193 students](extended-labelled-dataset-of-345-oer-sentences-with-ethnic-bias-annotations-from-193-stude.md) - A dataset released by Josmario Albuquerque and colleagues containing 345 contextualized OER sentences annotated by 193 higher-education students for perceived ethnic bias, with contextual metadata, aggregate labels, bias scores, and reproducibility code.
* [eXtended Reality Presence Scale (XRPS)](extended-reality-presence-scale-xrps.md) - The XRPS is a 17-item Likert survey developed and validated by Gandolfi et al.
* [Extended verbal protocol dataset of 15 e-learning design team meetings](extended-verbal-protocol-dataset-of-15-e-learning-design-team-meetings.md) - A dataset of video-recorded and transcribed project meetings from two interdisciplinary higher-education e-learning course-design teams, compiled by Rapanta et al.
* [External Representation Selection Tutor (ERST)](external-representation-selection-tutor-erst.md) - ERST is an adaptive educational system developed to individualise and support learners' choices among information visualisations during reasoning tasks.
* [EyelearnMR](eyelearnmr.md) - EyelearnMR is a mixed-reality HoloLens 2 application developed by Tan CJM et al.
* [EyeSi and HelpMeSee virtual reality cataract surgery simulators](eyesi-and-helpmesee-virtual-reality-cataract-surgery-simulators.md) - EyeSi and HelpMeSee are virtual-reality cataract-surgery simulation systems developed and operated by their respective commercial and training organizations for ophthalmology residents and other surgical trainees.
* [Eyesi Direct Ophthalmoscope Simulator](eyesi-direct-ophthalmoscope-simulator.md) - A VRmagic virtual-reality simulator that provides direct ophthalmoscopy practice, case-based training, skill testing, feedback, and instructor monitoring for medical learners.

#### F {: #letter-f }

* [F-L-I-P framework of flipped learning](f-l-i-p-framework-of-flipped-learning.md) - The Flipped Learning Network's framework for implementing flipped learning through flexible environments, a student-centered learning culture, intentional content, and professional educators.
* [Faces task](faces-task.md) - A computerized behavioral task developed by Bialystok, Craik, and Ryan that measures response suppression, inhibitory control, and task switching through speeded responses to gaze and eye-color stimuli.
* [Facilitation Behavioural Assessment Tool](facilitation-behavioural-assessment-tool.md) - A 32-competency, three-category assessment instrument developed by the VAST Community of Practice to evaluate healthcare simulation-facilitation performance and support faculty development, including in low-resource settings.
* [Facing History and Ourselves](facing-history-and-ourselves.md) - A character-education curriculum developed and delivered by Facing History & Ourselves that uses historical events, especially the Holocaust, to help middle and high school students examine identity, moral reasoning, and civic responsibility.
* [Factory Craft](factory-craft.md) - A Minecraft-based game-based learning system developed by Yanjun Pan and colleagues that teaches middle-school computational thinking through factory-building gameplay, planning tools, and Canvas LMS integration.
* [FACTRIA (Framework of Factors in the Analytical process and the data Context for Responsible Institutional Analytics)](factria-framework-of-factors-in-the-analytical-process-and-the-data-context-for-responsibl.md) - A flexible, evidence-informed framework proposed by Marques et al.
* [FACTRIA-aware chatbot](factria-aware-chatbot.md) - A web-based chatbot developed by Marques et al.
* [Faculty diversity pipeline programs (State Doctoral Scholars Program, STRIDE, California Pre-Doctoral Program)](faculty-diversity-pipeline-programs-state-doctoral-scholars-program-stride-california-pre.md) - A set of initiatives providing doctoral mentoring, networking, financial or preparatory support, and hiring-committee workshops to diversify the professoriate, run by the Southern Regional Education Board, Florida International University, and the University of California system respectively.
* [Failure Free Reading](failure-free-reading.md) - Failure Free Reading is a scripted language-development and reading-intervention program for struggling Kindergarten–grade 12 readers, combining teacher instruction, talking software, workbook exercises, and independent reading activities.
* [Fair Grader 2000](fair-grader-2000.md) - Fair Grader 2000 is NISSIN's standardized non-contact 3D scanning and scoring system for objectively evaluating dental cavity-preparation morphology, cutting volume, and volume ratio against a reference model.
* [Fall 2020 MAP Growth remote-versus-in-person comparability dataset](fall-2020-map-growth-remote-versus-in-person-comparability-dataset.md) - A dataset of fall 2020 NWEA MAP Growth assessment scores from more than 535,000 K–8 students in 147 districts, assembled and analyzed by Megan Kuhfeld and colleagues to compare remotely and in-person administered tests.
* [Family and Friends 2 MultiRom](family-and-friends-2-multirom.md) - Family and Friends 2 MultiRom is Cambridge University Press's accompanying multimedia software providing game-like, computer-based grammar activities for learners using the Family and Friends 2 coursebook.
* [Family Caregiving Competencies for Level One Nursing Education (FCG-C)](family-caregiving-competencies-for-level-one-nursing-education-fcg-c.md) - The FCG-C is a four-domain framework of 19 entry-level family-caregiving competencies developed by a national consortium of nurse educators for prelicensure nursing programs.
* [Family Check-Up (FCU)](family-check-up-fcu.md) - Family Check-Up is an ecological, school-based, family-centered intervention developed and delivered by trained providers using assessment, feedback, motivational interviewing, and tiered support to address family, behavioral, and academic needs.

* [Guiding Principles for Enacting SoLD-Aligned Teacher Preparation framework](guiding-principles-for-enacting-sold-aligned-teacher-preparation-framework.md) - A Darling-Hammond et al.

#### H {: #letter-h }

* [Holistic Critical Thinking Scoring Rubric (HCTSR)](holistic-critical-thinking-scoring-rubric-hctsr.md) - The HCTSR is a rubric developed for rating the quality of critical thinking demonstrated in learners’ written or verbal work across educational programs and assessment contexts.

#### I {: #letter-i }

* [Improving Chicago Schools: The Students Speak, 1997 and Improving Chicago Schools: The Teachers' Turn, 1997](improving-chicago-schools-the-students-speak-1997-and-improving-chicago-schools-the-teache.md) - A pair of student and teacher surveys administered by the Consortium on Chicago School Research to measure views of school environment, classroom learning, parent involvement, school governance, and teachers' professional work life.

* [Improving Writing Quality intervention delivered by the Calderdale Excellence Partnership](improving-writing-quality-intervention-delivered-by-the-calderdale-excellence-partnership.md) - A Calderdale Excellence Partnership intervention for Year 6 pupils that combines memorable experiences with Self-Regulated Strategy Development writing instruction and associated teacher professional development.

* [INCLUD-ED project](includ-ed-project.md) - A European research project that identified Successful Educational Actions, including dialogic leadership and interactive groups, for inclusive school transformation and community participation.
* [Incredible Years Teacher Classroom Management (IY TCM) program](incredible-years-teacher-classroom-management-iy-tcm-program.md) - A six-day universal teacher-training and coaching programme developed by The Incredible Years for elementary teachers, focused on teacher–student and teacher–parent relationships and effective classroom management.

* [Informal Reasoning Fallacy Instrument (IRFI)](informal-reasoning-fallacy-instrument-irfi.md) - A 50-item multiple-choice assessment developed by Ramasamy to measure undergraduate reasoning quality across five informal fallacies using a 0–2 scoring rubric.
